summary: Identifies the connection from the station DC distribution to the switchroom control system.
description: Identifies the connection from the station DC distribution to the switchroom control system. A room DC interface connects station battery distribution, alarm contacts and operating circuits. DC supplies may remain energized when the room's normal AC supply is unavailable, so their source and distribution boundaries must be shown separately.

In a switchroom, the station battery can continue supplying protection and breaker controls during an AC supply interruption. The alarm system should distinguish charger loss from a low battery condition. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Station DC feeder” at the input and “Room DC distribution” at the output. The feeder boundary differs from the battery boundary.
